{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full series to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract and print the highest mean species
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'Highest mean species: {highest_mean_species}')

# Explicitly print the mean values for each species
print(f'Mean flipper length - Adelie: {mean_flipper_by_species["Adelie"]}')
print(f'Mean flipper length - Chinstrap: {mean_flipper_by_species["Chinstrap"]}')
print(f'Mean flipper length - Gentoo: {mean_flipper_by_species["Gentoo"]}')"}
